newsitem.title: USA: Paper Brent, Mar/Apr slide in late U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: Paper Brent, Mar/Apr slide in late U.S. trading.

text.p: Paper April Brent and the March/April spread slid in the U.S. aftermarket on Thursday in a continuing downward trend, traders said.
Four April Brent partials changed hands a total of 450 times: 200 times at $20.00 a barrel, 100 times at $19.95, 100 times at $19.93 and 50 times at $19.92.
London's IPE settled at $20.07 a barrel for the April contract.
The March/April spread traded at +40 cents and +42 cents, down from trades of +45 cents and +46 cents earlier in the day. Wednesday's U.S. aftermarket saw deals at +50 cents and +51 cents.
